It's a reminder of the ancient Hindu belief in the presence and power of various gods in the sky, such as Indra, the god of rain, Agni, the god of fire, and Varun, the god of water. In Hindu culture, the sky is also seen as a manifestation of the divine, and those named Bimansh may be seen as possessing a celestial and divine nature.
